description: Do hard things , its your responsibility to yourself 🥂 #LifeByDesign #IntentionalLiving #fyp
transcript: It is so important to do hard things. It is so important to make decisions and stick with them. When you make a decision and stick with it and completely detach yourself from the outcome, you've shifted yourself and placed yourself in a new timeline. When you do that, you speed the process. Sometimes we get stuck in the past and we roommate and we stay there. And it's difficult to get out. We have to spring forward. No one is coming to save us and it doesn't matter. It doesn't matter the outcome. It's fine. Whatever it will be is what it's supposed to be in that moment. And you have to be able to take control of your life and do the things that you're meant to do. And take care of the things that are your responsibility and your biggest responsibility is yourself. Happy Monday!
